name: gam-tools
title: GAM Tools
description: Quick commands to manage Google Workspace via GAM CLI
author: jdietz02

commands.name: user
commands.title: Manage Google User
commands.subtitle: GAM User Tools
commands.description: Manage domain users (info, create, update, suspend, list)

commands.name: group
commands.title: Manage Goolge Groups
commands.subtitle: GAM Group Tools
commands.description: Creating or Deleting Groups, add or remove members, add or remove managers, add or remove owners, and modify Grous using GAM

commands.name: drive
commands.title: Manage Googgle Drive
commands.subtitle: GAM Drive Tools
commands.description: Find and purge files, folders, or empty trash for users in a Google Group

preferences.name: gamPath
preferences.title: GAM Binary Path
preferences.description: Full path to GAM binary (defaults to ~/bin/gam/gam or /usr/local/bin/gam)

preferences.name: domains
preferences.title: Google Workspace Domains
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of domains (e.g. domain.com, sub.domain.com)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
